companyName: US Distributed Solar / Residential Solar Platform

result.requestedCompany: US Distributed Solar / Residential Solar Platform
result.rationale: The census label resolves to Macquarie's US Residential Solar tile, not a named platform. MGREF2 acquired 50% of a 268 MW portfolio of operating US residential rooftop solar projects, with an October 2020 investment date. Macquarie publishes no legal company name, website, operator or seller, and calls it a portfolio of projects. It is an unnamed asset bundle. The MGETS attribution is unsupported: direct fund-level reporting assigns the holding to MGREF2, while MGETS separately identifies Calibrant Energy as a distinct company.
